name: Black Deuces
description: Black Deuces, also known as Deuces Wild, is a street gang founded in 1961 in the Cabrini Green public housing projects on Chicago's Near North Side by Richard "Champ" Strong, a Devil's Disciples founder affiliated with the Black Disciple federation. The gang fought a violent war against the King Cobrastones for control of Cabrini Green, culminating in July 1970 when snipers killed Chicago police officers Sgt. James Severin and Officer Anthony Rizzato. In 1971, Richard Strong formed the civil rights front group B.L.A.C.K.S., after which the Black Deuces were absorbed into the Gangster Disciples, who controlled Cabrini Green until the projects were demolished by 2011.
